en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing the front view of a large, three-story civic building with a central tower-like section marked with the year 1896. The structure has a stone ground floor, stucco upper floors, mansard-style roof with dormer windows, and a stairway leading to the main entrance. People stand near the steps and a cart, with large trees framing the scene. Printed German text at the top identifies the location and function of the building, and a publisher line with date appears at the bottom.
